note: Retrieval eval question set. Each answerable entry has an expected_doc and an expected_substring: a hit is at least one top-k chunk from the right doc containing that substring (case-insensitive). Substring instead of chunk index so the ground truth survives chunk-size changes between V1 and V2.

schema.question: the text sent to /query or /api/ask
schema.expected_doc: filename in the corpus, or null for unanswerable
schema.expected_substring: substring that must appear in a retrieved chunk, or null for unanswerable
schema.notes: freeform, why this question is in the set
